reason: A DeepSeek Harness Web UI plugin for dragging local files or folders into the composer, resolving their local paths, and sending those paths without uploading or modifying the files.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面中拖入本地文件或文件夹，将解析出的本机路径以可移除标签加入消息并支持直接发送。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness web UI plugin that accepts dragged local files or folders, resolves their filesystem paths, and adds them as removable chips for sending.

capabilities: Accepts dragged local files and folders in a web UI
Resolves and inserts local absolute filesystem paths
Reads local filesystem metadata and may sample or hash file contents to distinguish candidates
Invokes bounded operating-system file-index or directory-search commands
Writes resolved paths into the conversation draft and supports sending them
Preserves native image attachment behavior for image-only drops
